Scope of Work: The service provider shall make all necessary arrangements for the successful con duct of the felicitation ceremony as per the specifications, quantities and requirements mentioned i n the GeM bid documents and specification documents. 2. Venue and Date: The ceremony shall be conducted at the venue and on the date and time specifi

ed by the Buyer. The service provider shall coordinate with the designated representative of the Bu yer for all event-related arrangements. 3. Stage and Decoration: The service provider shall arrange stage decoration, backdrop, seating ar rangements, floral decoration and other approved decorative items as specified in the GeM bid docu ments and specification documents. 4. Felicitation Material: The service provider shall supply bouquets, mementos, trophies, shawls, ce rtificates, citation folders or other felicitation items, as applicable, in the quantities and specification s indicated in the bid. All items shall be of satisfactory quality and approved by the Buyer before the event. 5. Sound and Lighting: The service provider shall provide the required sound system, microphones, speakers, lighting and other audio-visual equipment, wherever specified in the bid. All equipment s hall be functional and tested before commencement of the ceremony. 6. Manpower and Coordination: Adequate trained manpower shall be deployed for event managem ent, stage coordination, distribution of felicitation items and other specified activities. The service p rovider shall ensure punctuality, discipline and professional conduct of its personnel. 7. Timely Completion: All arrangements shall be completed sufficiently in advance of the scheduled commencement of the ceremony. The service provider shall ensure that all equipment and arrange ments are ready for inspection by the Buyer before the event. 8. Quality Assurance: All materials and services shall conform to the specifications mentioned in the bid. Any defective, damaged or substandard item shall be replaced by the service provider without additional cost to the Buyer. 9. Inspection and Acceptance: The Buyer or an authorised representative shall have the right to ins pect the arrangements and felicitation items before and during the event. Payment shall be process ed subject to satisfactory completion and acceptance of the contracted services, in accordance with GeM provisions. 10. Security and Discipline: The service provider and its personnel shall comply with the security inst ructions, entry procedures, photography restrictions and other directions issued by the authorised r epresentative of the venue. No photography, videography or disclosure of restricted information sha ll be undertaken without prior permission. 11. Cleanliness and Restoration: The service provider shall maintain cleanliness at the venue during the event and remove all materials, waste and temporary installations after completion, leaving the premises in a clean condition. 12. Price Inclusiveness: The quoted price shall include all costs required for execution of the specified scope of work, including manpower, transportation, loading/unloading, installation, disman tling and applicable taxes, as relevant to the bid. No extra payment shall be admissible for items or services already included in the awarded scope. 13. Compliance with Laws: The service provider shall comply with applicable statutory requirements, labour laws, safety requirements and the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and service- specific terms and conditions. 14. Cancellation or Rescheduling: Any cancellation, postponement or rescheduling of the ceremony shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable GeM contract conditions and instructions issue d by the competent authority. 15. Non-Performance: Failure to provide the contracted services or meet the stipulated specifications and timelines may result in action as per the applicable GeM terms and conditions and the contract. 16. No Unauthorised Substitution: The service provider shall not substitute specified items with ite ms of inferior quality or alter the agreed scope of work without prior written approval of the Buyer. 17. Payment: Payment shall be made through the GeM portal after satisfactory completion of the contr acted services, submission of the required invoice and supporting documents, and certification of ac ceptance by the authorised representative, as per applicable GeM procedures. 18. Acceptance of Terms: Submission of a bid shall signify the bidder's acceptance of the Buyer Adde d Terms and Conditions, subject to the applicable GeM rules and the provisions of the bid. . 10.
